candidates.claim: B is expected to have an opinion about whether Tom will be elected president

proposal_evidence.quote: Do you think Tom will be elected president ?

auditor.reason: The question 'Do you think Tom will be elected president?' grammatically presupposes that B is capable of forming and expressing an opinion on the matter, as questions addressed to a person about their beliefs presuppose the addressee's ability to hold such beliefs.
